suites.title: S2B intake — ignore list (Exceptional Email Master)

specs.title: a matching rule suppresses draft creation and logs WHICH rule matched
matching happens BEFORE creation, so no complaint or acknowledgement is produced
a rule on CC is enforced — proving To/CC/BCC are persisted and matched
an exception pattern overrides the ignore rule and the draft IS created
an inactive rule does not suppress
admin CRUD persists — a created rule survives and is really deleted
an @rbi.org.in sender receives NO automatic acknowledgement
an external citizen sender DOES receive an acknowledgement
same sender + identical subject with a CLOSED parent creates NO new draft and links to the parent
an OPEN parent is NOT a duplicate — live correspondence must still reach the officer
a different subject from the same sender is not a duplicate
redelivery of the same messageId does not create a second draft

suites.title: S2B intake — OCR gating (vernacular routed to a human)

specs.title: vernacular content is flagged, NOT OCR-processed, and routed to manual entry
the citizen original is preserved as the body — never replaced by a machine translation
plain English content is not flagged as vernacular
a vernacular message padded with Latin punctuation is still detected
a file over 2MB is rejected even when the client declares an allowed type
a file whose bytes contradict its declared content type is rejected

suites.title: S2B intake — ignored-email report and CSV export

specs.title: the report lists sender, subject, timestamp and matched rule
the CSV export is downloadable and quotes a subject containing a comma
the stats endpoint reports a real ignored count, not a hardcoded zero
every intake message key resolves in all ten locales without falling back to English
